ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, labeled Grass, Cricket, Rat, Owl, Sheep, Wolf, Deer. Arrows point from Grass to Cricket, Sheep, and Deer; from Cricket to Rat; from Rat to Owl; there are also arrows from Rat, Sheep, Deer to Wolf. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate from food/prey to the animal that eats it. The question asks which one is a carnivore (meat-eating animal). In the diagram, Rat points to Owl, indicating that Owl eats Rat; Rat is an animal, so Owl eats animals, and is a carnivore.
